read.title: Read
read.description: Read bounded home, device, weather, energy, and security context.

write.title: Write
write.description: Set supported device properties directly. This can affect physical devices.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: Run scenes and higher-level space lighting actions. This can affect physical devices.

about.title: Secure agent access
about.description: MCP exposes only a curated catalog to installation-local clients. It is not a generic OpenAPI proxy.

endpoint.title: Installation MCP endpoint
endpoint.description: Use this URL with a trusted MCP client and the one-time bearer credential.

capabilities.title: Installation capability ceiling
capabilities.warningDescription: Write and trigger capabilities can change physical device state. Grant only what each client needs.

allowedOrigins.title: Additional allowed browser origins
allowedOrigins.description: Optional normalized origins for browser-based MCP clients. LAN server clients usually do not need this.
allowedOrigins.invalid: Use an absolute HTTP(S) origin without a path, query, fragment, or credentials.

clients.title: MCP clients
clients.subtitle: Create and manage installation-local agent credentials.
clients.securityDescription: Prefer LAN or VPN access and HTTPS. Credentials are shown once and cannot be retrieved later.
clients.empty: No MCP clients have been created.

clientForm.name: Name
clientForm.ceilingHint: Only capabilities enabled in the module configuration can be granted.

rotate.title: Rotate credential
rotate.warning: The current credential is revoked immediately. Connected clients must be updated with the new token.

token.title: Copy the MCP credential now
token.warningDescription: Save the credential for {name} in a secure password manager. It cannot be retrieved after this dialog closes.

confirm.revoke: Revoke the current credential for {name}? Connected clients will lose access immediately.
confirm.delete: Delete {name}? Its credential will be revoked and the client record cannot be recovered.

oauthConsent.title: Authorize MCP access
oauthConsent.subtitle: Review exactly what this remote client may do before approving access.
oauthConsent.offlineAccess: Refresh tokens allow continued access for at most 30 days, even when the grant lasts longer.
oauthConsent.physicalWarningTitle: This client can affect physical devices
oauthConsent.physicalWarning: Write or trigger access can change device state, run scenes, and affect people in the installation.
oauthConsent.invalid: This authorization request is invalid, expired, or no longer available.
oauthConsent.scopeRequired: Approve at least one MCP capability or deny the request.

scope.mcp:read: Read installation context and supported device state
scope.mcp:trigger: Run scenes and higher-level physical actions
scope.offline_access: Refresh access without asking again for up to 30 days

messages.configSaveFailed: MCP configuration could not be saved.
messages.copyFailed: The value could not be copied.
messages.capabilitiesOutsideCeiling: Client capabilities must stay within the module capability ceiling.
messages.loadFailed: MCP clients could not be loaded.
messages.createFailed: MCP client could not be created.
messages.updateFailed: MCP client could not be updated.
messages.rotateFailed: MCP credential could not be rotated.
messages.revokeFailed: MCP client could not be revoked.
messages.deleteFailed: MCP client could not be deleted.
